notes: Fresh two-engine sequential run, after the three isolated paired studies; all historical measurement directories are unchanged.
Each paired study alternates order across three pairs, using seven calibrated samples per document in each process.
Timing excludes startup and I/O and includes complete rendering and result disposal. Tests and compilation do not overlap timing.
GFM is not equal-output: Inkmark omits www.example.com autolinking and serializes tables differently.
Allocation calls and cumulative requested bytes are not peak or retained memory. Linked-attention before/after counts use the same counting source and profile options.

The temporary qualitative preparation-allocation tracer sampled every 251st allocation; it is not a timing or exact call-site count. Most sampled sites were divide_events, paragraph boundary additions, document exits, and list wrappers.
The benchmark harness is unchanged from 8e8296345c43f93a8a0460f4465d9ad044033a9a except prepare.py now also generates the supplemental linked-attention fixture.
